welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Shifokor siz bilan uchrashishdan oldin hamma narsani ko'rib chiqadi.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Bu sizning tashrifingizni yozuvingiz bilan bog'laydi.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Rahmat, {name}. Menga kerak bo'lgan narsam bor. Shifokorga yuborishdan oldin javoblaringizni ko'rib chiqaylik.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Rahmat Men sizning {complaint} haqida bir necha tezkor savollar beraman. Bu qachon boshlangan?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Raxmat Sizga nima sababdan kelganligi haqida bir necha tezkor savollar beraman. Bu qachon boshlangan?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Javobni kiriting yoki yuqoridagi taklifni bosing

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Jo'natishdan oldin uni tuzatish uchun har qanday buyumni bosing.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Agar sizning alomatlaringiz og'ir bo'lsa yoki hozirda og'irlashayotgan bo'lsa, kutmang shoshilinch xizmatlarga murojaat qiling.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Sizning alomatlaringiz tez orada ko'rish kerak bo'lgan narsani ko'rsatadi.

urgencyStep1Title.translation: Shuni aytish kerakki, sizning xulosangiz endi jo'natilgan.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Klinik guruh sizning tarkibiy tarixingizni darhol oladi.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Agar bu yomonlashsa, tez harakat qiling.

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Og'ir yoki to'satdan og'irlash darhol shoshilinch xizmatlarga murojaat qiling.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Bu avtomatik shoshilinchlik hisob-kitobi, tashxis emas.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Siz bu kasalxonada ilgari ham ko'rishgan bo'lsangiz kerak.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Ular sizning yozuvlaringizni saqlab qolishadi, shuning uchun sizning parvarishlash guruhingiz sizning to'liq tarixingizni darhol ko'radi.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Sizning joyingizni bilmadik. Yana bir marta sinab ko'rishga to'g'ri keling.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Sizning ma'lumotlaringiz parvarishlash guruhida, shifokor uni ochgan paytida sizga xabar beramiz.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Agar yomonlashayotgan bo'lsa, hozir harakat qiling.

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Agar sizning alomatlaringiz og'ir bo'lsa yoki to'satdan yomonlashsa darhol favqulodda yordam xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qiling yoki eng yaqin favqulodda yordam bo'limiga boring.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Biz sizning holatingizni yuqori ustuvorlik sifatida belgilab qo'ydik, shuning uchun parvarish jamoasi xabardor.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Tashrifingizdan keyin qanday bo'lganingiz to'g'risida bir nechta savollarga javob bering.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Bizga aytmoqchi bo'lgan yana bir narsa bormi?

checkinResultResolvedBody.en: We'll check in again {next} to make sure you're still improving.
checkinResultResolvedBody.translation: Siz hali ham yaxshilanayotganingizga ishonch hosil qilish uchun yana {next}-ni tekshiramiz.

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Javoblaringiz parvarish ekibiga yuborilgan, shifokor ularni ko'rib chiqib, kerak bo'lganda ularga murojaat qiladi.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: O'zingizning alomatlaringiz shoshilinch e'tiborga muhtoj bo'lgan narsani ko'rsatadi.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ushbu kuzatuv endi mavjud emas. O'zingizning hozirgi chek-inlaringizni ko'rish uchun kiring.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Tashrifingiz tasdiqlandi. Ushbu tashrifni kuzatish uchun bepul hisob yaratish va keyingi safar kodni o'tkazib yuboring.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Biz bir martalik kod yuboramiz eslab qolish uchun hech qanday parol yo'q.

authSecuredBy.translation: Triavi tomonidan kafolatlangan · HIPAA ga muvofiq

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Telefoningizni yoki elektron pochtangizni kiriting va biz kirish kodini yuboramiz.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Tarmoq xatosi. Aloqani tekshiring va yana urinib ko'ring.

errResendFailed.translation: Ularni qayta yuborolmadi. Yana sinab ko'ring.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Ushbu kod mos kelmadi. Yana sinab ko'ring.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Sizning xavfsizligingiz va bemorlarning ma'lumotlarini himoya qilish uchun siz faoliyatsiz bo'lgan vaqtdan keyin ro'yxatdan o'tdingiz.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Yangi tashrifni boshlash uchun ro'yxatdan o'tishni boshlang.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Ushbu dasturda parvarishlash qo'ng'iroqlari qo'ng'iroq qiladi · telefon raqamingiz hech qachon almashilmaydi.

dashSimulateCall.translation: Kelib kelayotgan parvarishlash qoʻngʻiroqlarini simulyatsiya qilish · demo

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Kim sizga qo'ng'iroq qilayotganini va qanday tovush qilayotganini tanlang.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Salom Jordan, kechki dozasining vaqti keldi...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: 9:30 da qo'ng'iroqlar yo'q 7:30 da qo'ng'iroqlar yo'q · xabarnomaga qaytadi

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Sizning parvarishlash liniyangiz faol bo'lib qoladi qo'ng'iroqlar va eslatmalarni boshqarish uchun qayta kiring.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; & amp; amp; & amp; amp; & amp; & amp; amp; & amp; amp; & amp; amp; & amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; amp; & amp; amp; amp; amp;

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Faqat siz va {hospital} bularni ko'rishingiz mumkin. Siz bilan bo'lishilgan qisqartmani o'qish uchun tashrif bosing.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Hozircha bu tashrif uchun hech qanday g'amxo'rlik talab qilinmaydi.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Bu siz bilan baham ko'rilgan qisqacha ma'lumot tashxis emas.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Ushbu tashrif olib tashlangan bo'lishi mumkin yoki u endi haqiqiy emas. To'liq tarixingizni ko'rish uchun qaytib boring.

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: Sizning parvarishlash guruhingiz tomonidan ozod qilindi

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Har bir ekranning tilini darhol o'zgartiradi.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ko'chirib bo'lmadi - tanlash va qo'lda nusxa olish

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Biz nimani himoya qilamiz va siz nimani nazorat qilasiz.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Kasalxonaga kirishdan oldin sizning ismingiz, aloqa ma'lumotlaringiz va bepul javoblaringiz yo'q qilinadi.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Hamma uchun tibbiy yordamni yaxshilash uchun identifikatsiya qilinmagan ma'lumotlarga yo'l qo'ying. Buni istalgan vaqtda o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Tanlovlarni eslatish va keyingi tekshiruvlarni qo'ng'iroq yoki bosish orqali o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Hisobvaraq va aloqa ma'lumotlarini doimiy ravishda o'chirib tashlang.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Tashrif tariqasining, dori-darmonlaringiz va tibbiy ko'rsatkichlaringizning nusxasini so'rang.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Bu sizning hisob qaydnomangiz va aloqa ma'lumotlaringizni doimiy ravishda olib tashlaydi.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Sizning g'amxo'rlik guruhingiz 72 soat ichida elektron pochta orqali tasdiqlaydi.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Formatni tanlang va eksportingizni so'rang. Biz uni tayyorlab, ro'yxatdan o'tgan elektron pochtangizga xavfsiz aloqa yuboramiz.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: 24 soat ichida sizning ro'yxatdan o'tgan manzilingizga xavfsiz aloqa yuboramiz.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Bu yerda hech qanday fayl yuklab olinmaydi - sizning yozuvlaringiz ro'yxatdan o'tgan elektron pochta pochtangizga xavfsiz yuboriladi.

ariaInviteLink.translation: Ilova qilish uchun bogʻ yoki kod

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Qoʻngʻiroq rad etildi, hech qanday aloqa yoʻq deb qayd etildi.

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Kasalxonaga yuborilgan taklif bog'ini bosing yoki ularning QR kodini skanerlang.

inviteInputLabel.translation: Ilova qilish uchun bogʻ yoki kod

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Bu Triavi taklif bog'iga yoki kodga o'xshamaydi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Amaldagi klinik kod sizni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tafsilotlarga olib boradi.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Amalli klinik kod sizni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tafsilotlarga olib boradi.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Brauzeringiz moslamalarida kameraga ruxsat bering yoki taklif qilish bog'ini qo'lda kiriting.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Hech qanday kamera aniqlanmagan. Buning o'rniga kasalxonangiz yuborgan taklif bog'ini kiriting.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kamera hozirda mavjud emas. Taklif bog'ini qo'lda kiriting.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
